# The page reloads itself when a new version is available
### Fixed
- **A new version of the page reloads by itself.** Before, only a banner "New version available – tap to update" appeared, and a page that had been open for a long time stayed on the old version. Now the page reloads itself as soon as no window is open and nothing is being typed; otherwise the banner sits above all windows and the page reloads once everything is closed. It checks every 30 seconds and when you come back to the page.

Update: `cd ~/immich-showcase && docker compose pull && docker compose up -d`. ☕ [ko-fi.com/frameside](https://ko-fi.com/frameside)
